answer.reason: The verses state two chief events of the bronze serpent: Moses made it and those bitten who looked at it lived, and Hezekiah later broke it in pieces.

clauses.english: was made by Moses and set on a pole, and those bitten who looked at it lived
clauses.quote: when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by Hezekiah after Israel had burned incense to it
clauses.quote: brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made

doubts: JHN 3:14 compares the lifted serpent to the Son of man; this is a comparison, not an event, so it was left out.
The summary already names Hezekiah breaking it, but the deed is told here once as it happened, with the incense burning as its reason.
